rdfs:label: Policy
rdfs:comment: A plan or course of action by an authority, intended to influence and determine decisions, actions, and other matters — e.g. a privacy, retention or collection-development policy.
notes: Not a licence (`urn:solid:LicenseDocument`) or a rights statement (`urn:solid:RightsStatement`); DCMI defines no subclass relation between them. Examples: privacy policy, retention policy, code of conduct. For machine-actionable access control on Solid pods, use the WAC vocabulary instead. Not acp:Policy (Solid Access Control Policy, http://www.w3.org/ns/solid/acp#Policy) or odrl:Policy (http://www.w3.org/ns/odrl/2/Policy). Those are machine-enforceable access or usage policies, while this is a descriptive document class.

history.note: Aligned comment with DCMI definition; removed implied 'broader than LicenseDocument' relation; disambiguated from acp:Policy and odrl:Policy.
